# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

MockWeb is an ASP.NET Core 8.0 Web API that serves as a mock HTTP testing suite (similar to httpbin). It provides endpoints for testing HTTP clients across content negotiation, authentication, redirects, delays, cookies, and more.

## Commands

```bash
# Build
dotnet build

# Run (HTTP on localhost:5218, Swagger UI auto-opens)
dotnet run --project MockHttp --launch-profile http

# Run (HTTPS on localhost:7192)
dotnet run --project MockHttp --launch-profile https

# Publish for deployment
dotnet publish MockHttp -c Release

# Run tests (no test project currently exists)
dotnet test
```

Swagger UI is available at `/swagger/ui` in development mode.

## Architecture

The project lives entirely under `MockHttp/` and follows Clean Architecture:

- **Controllers/** — HTTP concerns only; no business logic. One controller per feature group.
- **Services/** — All business logic lives here, injected as singletons.
- **Dtos/** — Data contracts between layers.

All three services are registered as **Singletons** in `Program.cs`:
- `IResponseGeneratorService` / `ResponseGeneratorService` — generates sample response payloads (JSON, HTML, XML)
- `IImageService` / `ImageService` — returns hardcoded minimal valid PNG/JPEG byte arrays (no external image libs)
- `IMockDataStore` / `MockDataStore` — in-memory `ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, string>` CRUD store; data does not persist across restarts

## Controller → Route Map

| Controller | Base Route | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `FormatsController` | `/api/formats/` | Content types: JSON, XML, HTML, text, paginated data |
| `ImagesController` | `/api/images/` | Binary image responses (PNG/JPEG), upload |
| `EchoController` | `/api/echo/` | Request inspection — mirrors headers, body, IP, UA |
| `DataController` | `/api/data/` | CRUD + file upload (single/batch) using MockDataStore |
| `SimulationController` | `/api/simulation/` | Status codes, delays (ms/s/random), timeouts, rate limits |
| `AuthController` | `/api/auth/` | Basic, Bearer, Digest, API Key, OAuth2 code flow |
| `CookiesController` | `/api/cookies/` | Get, set, delete cookies |
| `RedirectController` | `/api/redirect/` | 301/302/307/308, chains, loops, delayed redirects |

## Code Conventions

- **File-scoped namespaces**: `namespace MockHttp.Controllers;`
- **Primary constructors**: `public class DataController(IMockDataStore store) : ControllerBase`
- **Async/await** throughout controller actions
- **No ASP.NET Identity** — auth is simulated manually by inspecting the `Authorization` header
- XML support enabled via `AddXmlSerializerFormatters()` in `Program.cs`
- Swagger annotations (`[SwaggerOperation]`, `[SwaggerResponse]`) on all actions
- XML doc comments on public members (used by Swagger via `GenerateDocumentationFile`)
- Consistent response envelopes include `success`, `data`, `timestamp`, and HATEOAS `links`

## Key Constraints

- **No database** — `MockDataStore` uses `ConcurrentDictionary`; new features must not introduce a DB dependency
- Do not use `System.Drawing` or external image libraries — `ImageService` uses hardcoded byte arrays
- Do not use ASP.NET Core Identity for auth simulation — controllers manually inspect headers
- Swagger/OpenAPI is only enabled in the Development environment (`app.UseSwagger()` is inside `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())`)
